image_description: Two large airships (dirigibles) are visible against a sunset sky. The upper airship is airborne, displaying a classic cigar-shaped envelope with a gondola suspended underneath and tail fins. The lower airship appears to be on the ground or hovering very low near a hangar-like structure, showing similar features but with some visual distortion in the connection between the hull and the ground equipment. Text is visible on the sides of both airships.
